failure_reproduction.case: The installed command checkout, canonical status root, live supervisor source checkout, and task worktree can be distinct; only the validated worker lease identifies the source checkout whose worktree registry owns the task worktree.
failure_reproduction.prior_outcome: The first candidate overlaid coordination.repositories from PANTHEON_STATUS_ROOT, which still rejected a legitimate worktree when the status root was not the supervisor source checkout.
failure_reproduction.regression: test_pantheon_workspace_registration_uses_live_root_across_installed_runtime constructs four distinct paths and proves the validated lease workspace_source_root, rather than command or status config, anchors common-dir and worktree-registration validation.

implementation.config_boundary: load_config retains its existing installed-runtime configuration behavior and does not overlay repository configuration from PANTHEON_STATUS_ROOT.
implementation.path_authority: For an ORCH_RUN_ID command, _done_delivery_repository_root uses the already validated lease workspace_source_root and workspace_repository_id as the registered source checkout; commands without a worker run retain the existing repository registry fallback.
